question: design_conditional_execution.md §3.12 UNVERIFIED: does gen3 Magic Coat bounce side-targeting Spikes, or only user-targeting status?
method: constructed single-turn scenarios on the reference sim (deps/pokemon-showdown, gen3customgame, BattleStream): Xatu clicks Magic Coat, Skarmory clicks the probe move; the bounce signature is the re-emitted move line with `[from] Magic Coat`.

results.willowisp: BOUNCED (the bounced copy can miss — accuracy applies to the reflected move)
results.spikes: NOT bounced — `-sidestart|p1` lands on the Magic Coat user's OWN side

conclusion: The gen3 reflectable set is FOE-TARGETING STATUS moves (raw target == 'normal', not damaging). Side-targeting hazards (Spikes) and self/side moves are NOT reflectable. The `is_reflectable` predicate in intent_conditional._reflectable_table encodes exactly this.

provenance.note: run against the checked-out deps/pokemon-showdown dist (gen3customgame)
